title: Akil knows about the amputee athlete film his mother watched downstairs

tellings.quote: movie of athlete whose leg was amputed and he got into Special Olympics

plain: A mother from New Jersey named Manisha says her son, Akil, who appears in a documentary about telepathy among children who cannot speak, knew about a movie she had watched downstairs without him. She says he described it as a film about an athlete whose leg was amputated and who got into the Special Olympics. She tells this as something she saw herself, and if true it would suggest the boy picked up her experience by reading her mind.
